modal.title: Gerador de Sopas de Letras

projects.title: Batalha Naval RPG

bullets: Turn-based naval combat with RPG elements: characters, passives, skills, action points and varied AOEs
Online multiplayer (client/server) with join-code decoding, lobby flow and TCP networking alongside local CPU opponent
Qt GUI with draggable ship placement, 12x12 board rendering, hit/miss tracking and visual feedback

cover.ariaLabel: Main menu / game board UI screenshot

modal.title: Batalha Naval RPG

projects.title: DBS Item Shop

Admin panel for product and user management plus store endpoints for checkout and payment selection (MB Way, PayPal, Multibanco, etc.)
Server-side validation, templated includes (header/footer/head), and responsive UI for browsing and purchasing items

modal.title: DBS Item Shop
modal.desc: An item shop web application built with PHP and MySQL for a Master's course. Features include user registration/login, product pages, cart management, checkout with multiple payment methods, and an admin dashboard for managing products and users.

projects.title: Terminal Games Collection

bullets: Several small CLI games showcasing map/maze logic, entity movement and collision checks
Modular C++ code with headers and source files for game state, coordinates utilities and input handling
Educational course projects focused on algorithms, randomization, and basic AI behaviors

modal.title: Terminal Games Collection
modal.desc: A set of terminal/console games written in C++ during my bachelor's Programming course. These projects were designed to practice algorithmic thinking, game loop structure, randomized placement, collision detection and simple AI for enemy movement.

projects.title: Conveyor Sorting State Machines
projects.description: A PLC-style controller written in C that implements multiple interacting finite state machines connected by Modbus TCP to the sim env Factorio.
bullets: PLC controller in C with multiple finite state machines for operator panel and two conveyor subsystems
Cycle-based timers in milliseconds plus rising/falling-edge detection for sensor events
Modbus TCP for integration with an external simulator

cover.ariaLabel: Finite state machine diagram for conveyor sorting

modal.title: Conveyor Sorting State Machines
modal.sub: PLC-style FSM controller with Modbus I/O
modal.desc: Implements a deterministic control loop in C with multiple finite state machines for an operator panel and two conveyor subsystems (blue/green). Uses edge detection, millisecond timers, and Modbus TCP mapping to drive actuators and keep item counters—built to run against a simulator (Factorio-style).
